You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many hours does Kimo spend attending classes in one semester? On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, college student Kimo has three 1-hour classes each day. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, Kimo has two 2-hour classes each day. One semester has 16 weeks of school. Each class meeting counts as one class, regardless of whether it lasts one hour or two hours. Kimo attends classes on all five weekdays. His total class hours are averaged across those five class days. Each 1-hour class costs Kimo $180 per week. Each 2-hour class costs Kimo $260 per week.
